# AI NETRA GEO — Architecture

```text
OSM buildings -----> versioned catalog ---> Shapely STRtree --+
Google 2.5D (Earth Engine) -----------------> height lookup ---+----> FastAPI :8000
OSM Musi water polygons -------------------> river distances -+
TGRAC point GeoJSON -----------------------> point distances -+
                                                                |
                                                         Next.js + Leaflet :3000
                                                                |
TGRAC ArcGIS JSON -> TGRAC GeoJSON -> FastAPI :8001 ------------+
```

## Click workflow
1. User clicks map, browser calls `GET /building/query?lat=...&lon=...` on port 8000.
2. Shapely STRtree searches catalog geometry, then tests exact containment or nearby footprints.
3. API adds height, footprint area, mapped river distance, nearest government point and source evidence.
4. Frontend renders the building highlight and evidence panels.

## Government marker workflow
1. Browser requests `GET /waterlogging/locations` on port 8001.
2. Leaflet renders purple government-mapped location markers.
3. Dropdown navigation uses point coordinates to fly to a selected location.

Both APIs read locally generated files. The app does **not** query Google Earth Engine, OpenStreetMap or TGRAC live for every map click.
